about.title: About Savings Calculator
about.description: The Savings Calculator helps you plan and track your savings goals with compound interest calculations. Whether you're saving for a house, vacation, emergency fund, or retirement, this tool shows how regular deposits and interest can help you reach your financial targets. Plan your savings strategy by adjusting deposit amounts, frequency, and interest rates to see how different approaches affect your timeline and final savings amount.

faq.q: How much should I save each month?
faq.a: A common rule is to save 20% of your income, but this varies by individual circumstances. Start with what you can afford and gradually increase as your income grows. The key is consistency and building the habit.

faq.q: What's a good interest rate for savings?
faq.a: High-yield savings accounts typically offer 0.5% to 5% APY, depending on market conditions. Online banks often offer higher rates than traditional banks. Shop around for the best rates while ensuring FDIC insurance.

faq.q: Should I save daily, weekly, or monthly?
faq.a: More frequent deposits can slightly increase compound interest earnings, but the convenience of monthly deposits often outweighs the small difference in returns. Choose a frequency that matches your income schedule.

faq.q: How long will it take to reach my savings goal?
faq.a: This depends on your goal amount, current savings, deposit frequency, and interest rate. Our calculator shows exactly how long based on your specific inputs, helping you adjust your strategy as needed.
